requirements.requirement: The system must render a dedicated prescription behavior React component when structured prescription data is present in the message payload.
The system must integrate the prescription behavior component within the MessageBubble rendering pipeline without breaking existing message types.
The system must display prescribing patterns in a human-readable format based on transformed data from the rendering logic layer.
The system must display mapped condition labels associated with prescription behaviors.
The system must display the contribution of prescription behavior to the overall provider quality score.
The system must ensure the component styling is consistent with existing provider quality scorecard UI patterns.
The system must support reusable rendering of the prescription behavior component across multiple messages without duplication of logic.
The system must render the component in the correct position within the message flow relative to other scorecard elements.
The system must gracefully fall back to a non-structured text display when prescription behavior data is missing.
The system must not render the prescription behavior component when no prescription-related data is present in the message.
The system must handle partially populated prescription data by rendering only available fields without UI breakage.
The system must prevent runtime errors in MessageBubble when prescription data structure does not match the expected schema.
The system must support responsive layout behavior for the prescription component across standard viewport sizes.
The system must ensure the component renders within acceptable performance limits without noticeable delay in message display.
The system must isolate component styles to avoid unintended side effects on other MessageBubble elements.
